about.label: About Us
about.heading: A Madurai travel crew, not a call centre.
body: Pack & Go Vacation started with a simple idea — that planning a holiday shouldn't be more stressful than the work you're escaping from. We handle the hotels, the vehicle, the route, the stops worth making, and the ones worth skipping.
Whether it's a family temple circuit through Tamil Nadu, a group ride down to the Kerala coast, or a long weekend in Goa, you tell us the dates and the budget. We build the rest around it.
We're based in Madurai and we travel these roads ourselves. That's the difference — every itinerary we sell is one we'd take.

whyUs.label: Why Pack & Go
whyUs.heading: Six reasons people book with us twice.

items.heading: We know these roads
items.text: Our itineraries come from trips we've actually taken, not from a brochure.

items.heading: Fully customisable
items.text: Change the hotel, the dates, the route. The package bends to you.

items.heading: Transparent pricing
items.text: You see what's included and what isn't, before you pay a rupee.

items.heading: Local Tamil-speaking team
items.text: Talk to us in Tamil or English. No scripts, no runaround.

items.heading: Tours and rentals
items.text: One team for the full trip or just the vehicle — your choice.

items.heading: Reachable during the trip
items.text: Something goes wrong at 11pm in Munnar? You still get a person on the phone.

steps.heading: Tell us your plan
steps.text: Message us on WhatsApp with your destination, dates, and how many people are travelling.

steps.heading: Get your itinerary
steps.text: We send back a day-wise plan and a full quote. Change anything you like until it's right.

steps.heading: Confirm and go
steps.text: Pay the advance, get your confirmation, and turn up with your bags. We handle everything else.
